# SAC Attorneys LLP

> SAC Attorneys LLP is a business law firm serving San Jose, Silicon Valley, and the San Francisco Bay Area with expertise in commercial litigation, employment defense, and real estate disputes.

The firm provides comprehensive legal services to businesses throughout California, with a focus on practical solutions for commercial disputes, employment matters, and transactional needs. SAC Attorneys LLP offers free consultations and maintains offices strategically located to serve the Silicon Valley business community.
